{{2025–26 Northeast Conference men's basketball standings}}
The '''2025–26 Central Connecticut Blue Devils men's basketball team''' represented [[Central Connecticut State University]] during the [[2025–26 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Blue Devils, led by fifth-year head coach [[Patrick Sellers]], played their home games at the [[William H. Detrick Gymnasium]] in [[New Britain, Connecticut]] as members of the [[Northeast Conference]].

==Previous season==
The [[2024–25 Central Connecticut Blue Devils men's basketball team|Blue Devils]] finished the [[2024–25 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2024–25 season]] 25–7, 14–2 in [[2024–25 Northeast Conference men's basketball season|NEC play]], to finish as NEC regular-season champions.<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://necsports.com/news/2025/2/22/MBB_TournamentFieldSet_25.aspx|title=2025 Northeast Conference Men's Basketball Tournament Field Set|work=[[Northeast Conference|NEC]]|access-date=November 16, 2025|language=en}}</ref> They defeated [[2024–25 Le Moyne Dolphins men's basketball team|Le Moyne]],<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.courant.com/2025/03/05/central-connecticut-state-extends-nations-longest-winning-streak-advances-in-nec-tournament/|title=Central Connecticut State extends nation's longest winning streak, advances in NEC tournament|work=[[Hartford Courant]]|access-date=November 16, 2025|language=en}}</ref> and [[2024–25 Fairleigh Dickinson Knights men's basketball team|Fairleigh Dickinson]],<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.cbssports.com/college-basketball/news/central-connecticut-tops-fairleigh-dickinson-76-72-in-ot-will-play-st-francis-for-nec-title/|title=Central Connecticut tops Fairleigh Dickinson 76-72 in OT, will play St. Francis for NEC title|work=[[CBS Sports]]|access-date=November 16, 2025|language=en}}</ref> before being upset by #3 seed [[2024–25 Saint Francis Red Flash men's basketball team|Saint Francis]] in the [[2025 Northeast Conference men's basketball tournament|NEC tournament]] championship game.<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.post-gazette.com/sports/college/2025/03/11/ncaa-tournament-st-francis-basketball-nec-conference/stories/202503110105|title=St. Francis beats Central Connecticut State to win NEC tournament|work=[[Pittsburgh Post-Gazette]]|access-date=November 16, 2025|language=en}}</ref>

==Preseason==
On October 27, 2025, the NEC released their preseason coaches poll. Central Connecticut was picked to finish second in the conference.<ref name="poll">{{Cite news|url=https://necsports.com/news/2025/10/12/MBB_PreseasonMBBPoll_2526.aspx|title=Shark Hunt Begins: LIU Unanimously Named 2025-26 NEC Preseason Men's Basketball Favorite|work=NEC|access-date=November 16, 2025|language=en}}</ref>
